ZAF.note: Smart ID and passport applications via bank apps are service channels, no authentication service stated.
No link between civil register and ID stated.

facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs replies that under Section 15 of the Identification Act, No. 68 of 1997, anyone aged 16 or over must apply for an identity card.

ZAF.note: Gives 4,432,923 people aged 16+ without ID, but no enrolled count or population denominator.
Nothing on who operates or owns the system.
No register keyed on the ID number stated.

facts.fact: The Minister of Home Affairs says the department has a 2025/26 target to issue 2,750,000 Smart ID cards, and that Green ID books and Smart ID cards have been issued.
The Minister of Home Affairs cites the National Population Register as showing 4,432,923 South Africans aged 16 and over without a Green ID book or Smart ID card.
